SELECT underlying_code AS underlyingCode, MIN(underlying_name) AS underlyingName, underlying_type AS underlyingType, COUNT(*) AS contractCount, MIN(start_date) AS startDate, MAX(end_date) AS endDate
FROM base_option
WHERE underlying_code IN ('159915', '588000', '510500', '510300', '000852')
GROUP BY underlying_code, underlying_type
ORDER BY underlying_code
